title: cbr verdict-artifact
description: Verdict written by a fresh reviewer/tester agent for an SDLC quality gate (G4/G5a/G6/G7). Validated by hooks/verdict-gate.py before the user gate.

gate.description: Which SDLC gate this verdict is for.

decision.description: Overall verdict. PASS means the gate criteria are objectively met.

findings.description: Open findings. Any Critical finding blocks the gate regardless of decision.

verification.description: Commands run as evidence (G6/G7 require >=1 with result 'pass').

secretsScanned.description: Producer's claim it scanned for secrets; the validator scans independently.

producedBy.description: Agent/skill that produced this verdict, e.g. cbr:reviewer.
